turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are. Why did my son find out about a zero on his phone?
You need an answer? I asked the question, Hale.
Either Owen admits it in writing by Friday at 3 PM or the zero goes on his transcript.

Admits what, on what evidence, and under which section of your own procedure? Your procedure gives a first concern a supervised rewrite, not a confession under a deadline. Put that ultimatum in writing, because the principal is reading it today.
Those are the only two options. Pick one.
Neither. You haven't shown me one piece of evidence.
